brief:
Mahmoud Khalil, a pro-Palestinian activist, has filed a lawsuit against Columbia University and its dean alleging institutional racism targeting pro-Palestine students, Al Jazeera English reported. The suit centers on claims that the university has systematically discriminated against students engaged in pro-Palestinian activism on campus.

Khalil's legal action raises questions about academic freedom and the university's handling of campus activism related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The case comes amid broader debates over free speech protections for pro-Palestinian expression at American universities.
dek: Mahmoud Khalil sues Columbia University and its dean for alleged institutional racism targeting pro-Palestine students.
title: Pro-Palestinian activist sues Columbia University over alleged racism
